Storytelling & copy

Meadowhall

B2B sales campaign to reboot the retail mix at Meadowhall, Sheffield, a top 5 UK shopping destination, after their £60m refit. On behalf of Chocolate Ltd.

The work

Invention

The £60m refit at Meadowhall was a sight to behold. This is place with unrivalled footfall outside of London, a huge catchment area and even its own train station. The proposition speaks for itself. So much so that we decided to create a campaign brochure that used as few words as possible. This one speaks Louder Than Words .
